topics.title_zh: 特斯拉推送FSD V15：抛弃游戏引擎，引入实时AI视频渲染
topics.title_en: Tesla Rolls Out FSD V15: Ditching Game Engines for Real-Time AI Video Generation
topics.summary_zh: 特斯拉最新发布的FSD V15系统标志着自动驾驶可视化技术的重大范式转移。马斯克确认该系统不再依赖传统游戏引擎渲染，而是通过实时AI生成技术实现写实级的周边环境映射，这一极高计算负荷的方案正挑战车载SoC处理能力的极限。
topics.summary_en: Tesla's release of FSD V15 marks a paradigm shift in autonomous visualization. Elon Musk confirmed the abandonment of traditional game engines in favor of real-time AI video generation for photorealistic environment rendering. This compute-intensive approach directly stresses current SoC limits, signaling a move toward pure-AI environment synthesis.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 演进派 / 特斯拉支持者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 实时生成的环境模型消除了引擎转换的延迟与数据损失，能更精准地与神经网络的决策链路对接，为实现完全自动驾驶提供底层支撑。
perspective_pro.point_en: Real-time generation eliminates engine latency and data loss, allowing for seamless integration with neural network decision pipelines, essential for achieving true autonomy.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 安全质疑者
perspective_con.point_zh: 将核心显示路径从确定性代码转向生成式AI，引入了无法预知的“幻觉”风险。在高速驾驶决策中，显示内容的精确度若被生成式AI模糊化，极易诱发致命误判。
perspective_con.point_en: Moving critical display pipelines from deterministic code to generative AI introduces unpredictable 'hallucination' risks. If generative AI blurs precision in high-speed scenarios, it creates lethal misjudgments.

linked_tweets.author: Elon Musk
linked_tweets.content_zh:
@BLKMDL3 @wholemars 如果有人好奇：

自去年以来，我们已经有了一个像素完美的世界模型，这对于合成数据的生成至关重要。

汽车中的（小得多）版本是条件平均流模型，基于 Tesla 通用视觉编码器功能的最新序列，这些功能与插入到产生驾驶动作的 3B 编码器模型中的功能相同。

我们从这些 UVE 功能中分叉出来，然后运行一个单独的 ~1B 扩散模型。这会吸收先前生成的添加了噪声的现实视图，然后将其降噪到当前的可视化中。

然后它会生成一个小视频块（8 个图像，36 fps，UI 屏幕的分辨率）。这项工作由 TRIP 引擎在 18 Hz 的每个 UVE 帧上完成，并分布在 4 个周期内。

目前，由于计算限制，延迟有点高，但我们有办法沿着扩散转换器层交错更新的 UVE 功能，以减少大约 35% 的延迟。
linked_tweets.content_en:
@BLKMDL3 @wholemars In case anyone is curious:

We’ve had a ~pixel-perfect world model since last year, which is critical for synthetic data generation. 

The (much) smaller version of that in the car is a conditional mean-flow model, based on the recent sequence of Tesla Universal Vision Encoder features, which are the same ones that are plugged into the 3B encoder model that produces the driving actions. 

We fork off from these UVE features, then run a separate ~1B diffusion model. This takes in the previous reality-view generation with added noise and then denoises it to the current visualization. 

It then produces a small video chunk (8 images at 36 fps, at the resolution of the UI screen). This work is done by 1/2 of a TRIP engine every UVE frame at 18 hz and is spread over 4 cycles. 

Currently, the latency is a bit high due to compute constraints, but we have ways to interleave newer UVE features along the diffusion transformer layers to cut roughly 35% of the latency.

topics.title_zh: AI编程智能体虚火：模拟办公环境任务成功率不足10%
topics.title_en: AI Coding Agents Fail: Under 10% Success Rate in Simulated Workplace Environments
topics.summary_zh: 针对SWE-bench等基准测试的最新研究显示，AI编程智能体虽然在隔离测试中表现亮眼，但在复杂协作、多方反馈的真实工作流模拟中，任务成功率断崖式下跌至10%以下。这揭示了当前模型在复杂上下文维护与业务逻辑对齐上的核心缺失。
topics.summary_en: New research reveals that while AI coding agents excel in isolated benchmarks like SWE-bench, their success rate in simulated workplace environments drops below 10%. This exposes a critical gap in model capabilities regarding multi-agent coordination, persistent context maintenance, and alignment with complex business workflows.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 研发支持者 / 智能体派
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 大模型辅助编程开发者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 当前的失败率是系统整合期的阵痛。一旦Agent工作流与企业级CI/CD流程深度闭环，其生产力跃升将是量级上的改变，不应以孤立失败否认路径方向。
perspective_pro.point_en: High failure rates are growing pains. Once agent workflows achieve deep integration with enterprise CI/CD pipelines, the jump in productivity will be orders of magnitude, making it unwise to reject the path based on isolated failures.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 质疑者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 软件架构师与安全专家

perspective_con.point_en: 'Vibe-coding' creates a generation of 'starters' lacking deeper project integrity. Current models perform probabilistic fitting on code snippets rather than actual software engineering governance.

linked_tweets.author: CyrilXBT
linked_tweets.content_zh:
VIBE 编码并没有创造一代建造者。它创造了一代先发者。

麻省理工学院刚刚发表了关于人工智能编码的最令人不安的论文。

在编码代理出现后，他们跟踪了 App Store、Play Store 和 Chrome Web Store 上的每一个新应用程序。

使用自主代理的开发人员编写的代码增加了 25.5 倍。

承诺增长 240%。

实际发布？

上涨 30%。

情况变得更糟。

采用 Claude Code 等工具后，开发人员编写的行数增加了 7 倍，删除的行数增加了 12.2 倍。

30 天内放弃的回购协议从 60% 上升到 69%。

自 2025 年初以来，新应用的发布量大约增加了一倍。

用户参与度没有变化。

应用程序数量是原来的两倍。

使用它们的人数相同。

这一点我个人是有感觉的。

上个月我用 Claude Code 交付了三个“项目”。

几乎可以肯定，零个人使用过其中任何一个。

这是我的看法。

人工智能并没有让人们成为更好的建设者。

它让开始变得如此廉价，以至于结束变得毫无意义。

编写代码从来都不是瓶颈。

味道是。

审查是。

建造人们真正想要的东西是。

没有任何模型可以为您解决这个问题。
linked_tweets.content_en:
VIBE CODING DIDN'T CREATE A GENERATION OF BUILDERS. IT CREATED A GENERATION OF STARTERS.

MIT just published the most uncomfortable paper on AI coding.

They tracked every new app on the App Store, Play Store and Chrome Web Store after coding agents showed up.

Devs using autonomous agents wrote 25.5x more code.

Commits up 240%.

Actual releases?

Up 30%.

It gets worse.

After adopting tools like Claude Code, devs wrote 7x more lines and deleted 12.2x more.

Repos abandoned within 30 days went from 60% to 69%.

New apps launching roughly DOUBLED since early 2025.

User engagement didn't move.

Twice as many apps.

Same number of people using them.

I felt this one personally.

I shipped three "projects" last month with Claude Code.

Pretty sure zero humans used any of them.

Here's my take.

AI didn't make people better builders.

It made starting so cheap that finishing stopped meaning anything.

Writing code was never the bottleneck.

Taste was.

Reviewing was.

Building something people actually want was.

And no model is fixing that for you.

linked_tweets.author: Сarm1ne
linked_tweets.content_zh:
天哪……麻省理工学院的学生在 Citadel 和 Jane Street 竞赛的一场现场比赛中通过 GitHub 上免费的一个 Python 笔记本赚了 2600 万美元

第三名，一台笔记本，高盛1990年生产的型号：Black-Litterman。没有深度学习，没有 GPU，只有数学

自 10 月份以来，我对 9 只真实股票执行了他们的精确规则，并让 Claude Fable 5.2 做出每一次预测：纸质书上涨 2.1%，而 SPY 下跌 7.5%

首先了解它是如何工作的：

> 每个团队都获得相同的股票、实时价格和 3 位分析师的价格预测，然后比赛对投资组合进行实时评分

> Black-Litterman 从市场已经掌握的情况开始，并倾向于分析师，只要数学相信他们

> 夏普门只有在击败当前投资组合时才会保留新的投资组合，并且机器人完成了现场融资 2600 万美元

如何使用 Claude Code 运行它：

1.告诉Claude Code克隆并打开case3.ipynb

2. 首先让它在 case3data 上运行笔记本（它是为 Colab 编写的，因此 Claude 将 Google Drive 路径替换为本地路径）

3.要求Claude将真实股票和真实分析师价格目标互换作为观点，雅虎两者都有

4. 保留他们的夏普门，这样新的目标只有在击败当前的书时才进入

5. 每天结束后运行一次并将每个目标记录到 csv

6. 让 Claude 决定每次重新平衡，执行还是保留，并给出一个理由（这就是《神鬼寓言 5.2》视频中所做的）

7. 每周纸质交易这本书并与 SPY 进行比较

8. 限制单笔空头，原始规则有时要求 89% 的净空头

9. 仅在您喜欢的几个月的纸质结果后才转移到真实账户

我不再多说：
linked_tweets.content_en:
HOLY F*CK... MIT students made $26 MILLION in ONE live round at a Citadel & Jane Street contest... from a single Python notebook that's on GitHub for free

3rd place, one notebook, the model Goldman Sachs built in 1990: Black-Litterman. no deep learning, no GPUs, just MATH

i ran their exact rule on 9 real stocks since October & let Claude Fable 5.2 make every call: the paper book is up 2.1% while SPY dropped 7.5%

first understand how this works:

> every team got the same stocks, live prices & 3 analysts' price predictions, then the contest scored the portfolios live

> Black-Litterman starts from what the market already holds & tilts toward the analysts, only as far as the math trusts them

> a Sharpe gate keeps a new portfolio only when it beats the current one, & the bot finished the live round $26 MILLION up

how to run it with Claude Code:

1. tell Claude Code to clone https://t.co/dhTzZnC1fI & open case3.ipynb

2. have it run the notebook on their case3data first (it was written for Colab, so Claude swaps the Google Drive paths for local ones)

3. ask Claude to swap in real stocks & real analyst price targets as the views, Yahoo has both

4. keep their Sharpe gate, so a new target only goes in when it beats the current book

5. run it once a day after the close & log every target to a csv

6. let Claude decide each rebalance, execute or hold, with a reason (that's what Fable 5.2 does in the video)

7. paper trade the book & compare it with SPY every week

8. cap any single short, the raw rule sometimes asks for 89% net short

9. move to a live account only after a few months of paper results you like

i won't say anything more:

topics.title_zh: 黎曼猜想被证明：Lean形式化验证掀起数学自动化浪潮
topics.title_en: Riemann Hypothesis Formally Proven: Lean Verification Triggers Math Automation Wave
topics.summary_zh: 斯坦福数学家勒文特·阿尔珀格通过Lean语言完成黎曼猜想的证明，并经由Mathlib社区经1700万行代码确认无误。这一事件标志着机器形式化验证正式成为数学界认可的“真理裁判”，深刻改变了人类探索复杂数学问题的范式。
topics.summary_en: Stanford mathematician Levent Alpöge has formally proven the Riemann Hypothesis using Lean, verified by the Mathlib community through 17 million lines of code. This landmark event confirms machine-aided formal verification as the gold standard for mathematical truth, fundamentally shifting the paradigm of exploring complex mathematical conjectures.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 愿景派 / 计算数学推动者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 形式化验证消除了学术界对于人类证明逻辑漏洞的长期猜疑。Lean作为基础设施，实现了数学真理的客观、可重现与可执行化，是文明认知的重大迭代。
perspective_pro.point_en: Formal verification eliminates the lingering suspicion of logical flaws in human-led proofs. Lean serves as infrastructure that renders mathematical truth objective, reproducible, and executable—a major iteration in civilization.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 传统主义派 / 数学哲学家
perspective_con.point_zh: 依赖庞大的形式化代码库验证，削弱了人类直觉在数学构思中的地位。当证明过程变为代码堆砌，数学的审美与发现感将逐渐丧失。
perspective_con.point_en: Reliance on massive formal codebases diminishes the role of human intuition in mathematical conception. When proofs become stacks of code, the inherent beauty and spirit of mathematical discovery may be lost.
